messages:
Emma: heads up — seeing a small batch of trial grants that the Support Console marks as successful but no ledger entries exist; customers didn't receive credits. tickets: #2489 #2492 #2501.
Olivia: can you paste a request id / example grant id so eng can trace?
Emma: sure — here's one: grant_id=g_9f2, request_id=req_7c3f, customer=cus_73A. from support-tool logs:
```
POST /admin/grants HTTP/1.1
Idempotency-Key: 7c3f4a2b
Body: {"customer_id":"cus_73A","amount":1000,"reason":"trial"}
200 OK
{"status":"applied","grant_id":"g_9f2","message":"queued for ledger"}
```
Emma: but when I query ledger service: `GET /ledger/entries?grant_id=g_9f2` -> 404. UI still shows success.
Raj: that looks like the backoffice accepted the request and returned before the ledger write completed. any consumer/queue errors around the time? which consumer module is responsible for committing ledger?
Emma: consumer logs show an ack then a later DB error. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T16:12:03Z] consumer-grants pod-3 INFO acking message req_7c3f
[2026-03-15T16:12:03Z] consumer-grants pod-3 ERROR commit failed: DEADLOCK DETECTED (SQLSTATE 40P01)
```
Tess: if ack is sent before tx commit, message gets dropped despite failed commit. how many customers affected?
Emma: ~6 in last 24h, support already manually applied credits for 4, 2 still pending. no obvious double-grants. billing totals not yet impacted but could if left unresolved.
Mike: SRE — which deployment revision and node pool? any restarts or redelivery spikes? also check rabbitmq unacked counts.
Emma: deployment rev r-2026-03-14, consumer replicas 3 on pool-gpu. no recent restarts listed, rabbitmq shows normal backpressure except a brief spike at 16:11:58.
Raj: likely causal chain: consumer acks on receipt then does DB work -> deadlock -> message lost. fix: ensure ack happens after successful DB commit OR use transactional outbox pattern. quick mitigation: flip feature-flag `grant_ack_after_commit` to true for canary. I'll open ENG ticket and add reconciler job to scan grants without ledger entries.
Olivia: created ENG-1427 and assigned to Raj, added repro steps and one example customer. also added an alert to PagerDuty: `grant.missing_ledger > 1 in 10m`.
support-bot: incident-alert created: grant-missing-ledger count=3 threshold=1 window=10m -> PagerDuty triggered.
Raj: I'll push a small hotfix to staging to delay ack until commit completes, and add metrics around commit_time and ack_count. will canary and then roll to prod if green. ETA: 45m.
Mike: I'll hold any autoscaler churn and monitor the consumer pods during canary, plus block automated restarts for 1h. also adding a manual reconcile runbook (steps to run `scripts/reconcile_missing_grants.sh` and force ledger writes).
Tess: do we have an idempotency gap? if reconciliation retries could double-apply credits, we need to use grant_id dedupe on ledger side.
Raj: noted — ledger already dedupes by grant_id, but recon job will check ledger first. I'll add an explicit check to avoid duplicates.
Emma: thanks team. I've updated the 2 pending tickets with manual workarounds and ETA. please post status updates in this thread when canary finishes.
Olivia: ping when hotfix deployed to staging.
Raj: staging deploy done, running smoke with the failing request id now. will report back in ~10m.
Mike: monitoring: no new missing-ledger alerts during staging smoke.
Raj: canary in prod started 16:45Z. no regressions so far, rolling to full prod in 20m unless we see errors.
Emma: great, keep me posted and I'll mark affected support tickets as "in-progress - awaiting fix".
Olivia: ENG-1427 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1427 (contains repro, logs, manual reconcile steps).
Emma: thanks all :thumbsup:
